subject: Request to preserve demo window during PO clearance
messages:
From: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@acmehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-11-28T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Request to keep demo environment active while PO processes

Hi Vivek,

Quick note — our procurement team is finishing up the PO but theres a short bottleneck in finance approvals. We have an executive demo scheduled for Dec 3rd and the proof-of-concept needs to remain live for that meeting. If the environment goes cold before then well lose momentum.

Can Redwood temporarily keep our sandbox/demo account active or provide a small, time-limited credit allowance so the team can run the final workflows for the exec review? We expect the PO to land by EOD Dec 2nd, but I dont want to gamble. I attached the draft PO and a short note from procurement (acme_po_draft.pdf).

What would you be able to do on short notice?

Thanks,
Sara Hayes
Director, Product Strategy
Acme Health

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-29T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to keep demo environment active while PO processes

Hi Sara — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the draft PO. Were happy to help preserve the demo for your Dec 3 exec review. Ill route this to Sales Ops but wanted to propose a concrete, time-limited option to keep things moving:

- Offer: a temporary, non-renewing demo-continuity credit of 15,000 tokens applied to your sandbox account.
- Duration: 7 days from the moment we activate it (enough to cover your Dec 3rd review).
- Conditions: Credit expires automatically; full billing via PO will resume once finance clears.

If that works, Ill ask Priyom to activate the credit and attach a usage snapshot so you can see the buffer. Also, could you confirm the earliest ETA your procurement team gave for the PO? If you expect earlier than Dec 2, we can shorten the window.

Looping in Priyom for approval and activation.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwoodinference.com

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@acmehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-30T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to keep demo environment active while PO processes

Vivek / Sara — approved.

Ive provisioned a one-time demo-continuity grant of 15,000 tokens to Acme Healths sandbox. Activation details:
- Activated: 2027-11-30T15:45:00-08:00
- Expires: 2027-12-07T15:45:00-08:00 (automatic expiry)
- Note: Credits are for sandbox/demo usage only and cannot be applied to paid invoices.

Im attaching a short usage snapshot we captured before applying the credit so you can see baseline consumption (demo-usage-snapshot.csv). Please let us know if you need the grant shifted to a different account or toggled earlier/later.

Well also tag the HubSpot deal (ACME-3789) and record the credit for internal audit. Priyom Das
Sales Operations
priyom@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: demo-usage-snapshot.csv (CSV, 12 KB)

---

From: Sara Hayes <sara.hayes@acmehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request to keep demo environment active while PO processes

Vivek / Priyom — thank you both, this is perfect and exactly what we needed. Well run the executive demo on Dec 3 with the sandbox active and confirm when the signed PO is sent; procurement is aiming to submit by EOD Dec 2. Ill follow up here if anything slips.

Appreciate the quick turn.
Sara
